fichas.title: Daylight: Window Lighting
fichas.summary: A reference page on window daylighting, covering lighting aims and requirements, daylight assessment with models, and the effects of sky conditions, window positions, projections, windowsill heights, light shelves, and atrium floors on daylight distribution.
uses: Assess daylight distribution under different sky conditions
Guide window sizing and daylight-enhancing design

DAYLIGHT
Window Lighting

Aims~o-o

0 Control of daylight and artificial lighting: 1, daylight pattern D%; 2, daylightenhancing lighting; 3, prevention of glare; 4, reflecting surface

-

no glare, direct or indirect
differentiated shadowing
optimal daylight lighting, control
view out at all times of year
balanced lighting environment day and night
colourful daylight-enhancing but similar lighting, in the depths
of the room
reduced artificial lighting component
matt, light, pastel-coloured surfaces

Requirements

11!1!11

-DIN 5034
- European Standard for Computer Workplaces
- German state building regulations

~11-14 m approx. 30%
~14 m approx. 35% of the room area
